event_name: Document 35 Date 11 November 2018 Time 17:06 2018 BRAZILIAN GRAND PRIX 8 - 11 November 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and of Appendix H, Article 2.4.5.1 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that car 14, Fernando Alonso ignored blue flags, which were shown for a significant number of corners.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
